newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-CAVALIER JONES OPTS FOR CAUTION.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CAVALIER JONES OPTS FOR CAUTION.

text.p: Former Australian test batsman Dean Jones abandoned his usual cavalier strokeplay to give Derbyshire the edge on the opening day of their county championship match against Nottinghamshire on Wednesday.
Nottinghamshire's hopes of exploiting a green Trent Bridge wicket were scuppered by Derbyshire skipper Jones who spent 243 minutes compiling a painstaking unbeaten 71.
He struck only four boundaries as he guided his side to 283 for five before bad light stopped play.
In start contrast, Kevin Curran hit a cavalier 91 not out to lead Northamptonshire's onslaught on a poor Lancashire attack at Old Trafford.
Curran hammered nine fours and two sixes in his 146-ball innings as Northants cruised to 281 for four.

Australian opener Matthew Hayden braved the weather long enough to score his first half century this season against county opposition to put Hampshire on 94 for one against Glamorgan at Cardiff. He was 54 not out when the weather won the day.
Play was washed out in four county matches.
